title: 高松宮記念の後に・カワイイ頂上決戦へ

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I got first place!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I got first place!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Ehe, it really does feel good. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But it's not over yet. Tomorrow…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The results of the first Cutie ♪ Derby will come in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, around noon, I finish counting the likes and meet up with Curren Chan and Biko Pegasus. Of course, they're streaming the results announcement.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan and Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Gulp!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oof! I lost!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They had almost the same number of likes. Curren Chan made more posts, which ended up just barely pushing her ahead.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All the same, I lost both the race and the Cutie ♪ Derby… There's no getting around it.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Curren. How did I lose?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm… If I had to say, I'd say it's probably because of the audiences we were aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Take me, for example. I'm always cute. And everyone likes cute, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: As long as I put myself out there, I can reach anyone. I think that's why I get so many likes from people of all ages and genders.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But instead of reaching out to everyone you could, you chose to stick with what you personally think is fun.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Now I can play around and recreate scenes from Carrot Ranger! All my fellow hero fans really loved it too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I see… I wasn't appealing enough to people outside of my core audience.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's not necessarily a bad thing. It might not have worked out for this competition, but that's just because of the specific guidelines we set to determine a winner.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Besides, what's important is that the Takamatsunomiya Kinen was more fun because we raced together. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: See? Look! ♪

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text: "For today's headline, please take a look at this video!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "Woooo! Chatter… Curren Chan!"

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text: "That was footage from yesterday's Takamatsunomiya Kinen. We've received reports that there were three times more spectators than usual."

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text: "I heard about that. One of the runners planned some special project, which apparently brought more people to the course."

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text: "Cute Curren Chan!"

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text: "Huh?! Um, well, in any case, it looks like we'll have to keep our eyes on the future sprints!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The race was so exciting that it even made the news. Don't you think that's amazing?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And for that, I have to say thanks, Biko.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I-I see!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Thank you too, Curren Chan. I've really grown thanks to our battle.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The next time we meet, I'll be an entirely new me. And when that time comes… I'll definitely defeat you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haha! You're on! I'll be happy to squash your big comeback before it begins. ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: …Wow, Curren. You might fit the bad guy role even more than I thought…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Bad guy? Awww, at least make me the Dark Lady of Cuteness or something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Curren Chan wins the first battle of the Cutie ♪ Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the war is hardly over. We go straight to a diner for a strategy meeting.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So, about my next race…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So, about my next race…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I wanna run in the Sprinters Stakes again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's unusual for Curren Chan to suggest a race herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There aren't that many G1 sprints so I was going to suggest running the Sprinters Stakes again myself, but…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I think I mentioned before that I spoke with all the Cutie ♪ Derby participants before I announced it, right? Well…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: At that time, they all said they were planning to run in the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Don't you think that makes for a super simple, perfect next step?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm on a high after beating Biko.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I wanna take this momentum and use it to go up against everyone all at once! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle, Hishi Akebono, and Sakura Bakushin O. They're all the absolute cream of the crop.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, though. It's not like we need different tactics for each of them, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, though. It's not like we need different tactics for each of them, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's a sprint, after all. I can win if I just run faster than everyone else… Right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's not wrong, but the race isn't the only thing we need to consider strategy-wise.
choice_data_list: You have to think about the Cutie ♪ Derby too.
You have to think about the Cutie ♪ Derby too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Likes are counted separately on each platform. This time, we only had to worry about UmaTok, but next time we'll have to keep track of every platform.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: No worries there, either. Do you think I'm gonna cut corners?
choice_data_list: No, and that's exactly why I'm worried.
No, and that's exactly why I'm worried.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …Right.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But really, don't worry! I can already see that my future's bright.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: My victory against Biko went according to plan, so now I just need to put together a dramatic "final showdown." That'll make the Cutie ♪ Derby an even bigger deal!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Then, with everyone watching, I'll beat everyone and jump straight to the top!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: After that, I'll forever live in everyone's hearts as the most beloved runner ever!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'll finally be able to show you how cute I am standing amidst thunderous applause. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'll finally be able to show you how cute I am standing amidst thunderous applause. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan chooses an even harder path. We'll find out what challenges await her along the way to the Sprinters Stakes!
